create_worldstate: create a WorldState instance to initialize an OpenSpiel game with configurable parameters and random seed
test_is_terminal: test whether the current game state has reached a terminal condition
get_actions: get the list of legal actions available to the current player or chance node
apply_actions: apply a sequence of player actions to advance the game state through the game tree
get_chance_policy: get the probability distribution over chance node outcomes with optional perturbation
